_comment: Workbook exercise plant-chw-reset-pumping (docs/workbook/plant-chw-reset-pumping.md): the chilled-water distribution side of the lbnl-chiller plant. chw_plant_reset regresses chiller 1's leaving-water temperature on the outdoor dry-bulb over its running, occupied hours (the run gate is the chiller's power: its status point is an enable, see the data issues) and reports the loop delta-T against the rule's fixed 8 F design minimum, which has no parameter. chw_pump_dp_reset reads the secondary loop's lead pump speed (CWL_SEC_PM_SPD_1) and its DP setpoint (CWL_SEC_DPSPT), both mapped since 0.97; its near-full (90%) and near-minimum (25%) bands are fixed in the rule. Neither rule needs a calibrated ceiling, so there are no params.
